name: When is the best time to start planning a custom home construction project?
description: Start planning a custom home 18-24 months before your desired move-in date. This allows time for design, permits, material selection, and buffer for delays.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start planning a custom home construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start planning a custom home construction project is typically well in advance of your desired move-in date, often 18-24 months prior. This allows ample time for architectural design, securing necessary permits, and careful material selection, which can be a lengthy process depending on the complexity and local jurisdiction. Early planning also provides a buffer for unexpected delays and ensures you can secure preferred contractors and designers. Starting early allows for a more relaxed and thoughtful decision-making process.
